notes: 7.0.6: a large batch of fixes found with real-world documents — translations no longer drift onto the neighbouring segment, Excel files with tables open without repair, footnote markers / links / fields / inline formatting are kept across Word, PowerPoint, ODT, EPUB, HTML and Markdown, codes and numbers are left untranslated, and fewer false warnings. / 7.0.6：修复了一大批用真实文档发现的翻译问题：译文不再错位到相邻段落，含表格的 Excel 不再需要修复才能打开，Word、PPT、ODT、EPUB、HTML、Markdown 的脚注标记、链接、自动字段和局部格式都会保留，代码和数字不再被翻译，误报的提示也更少。
